battle.name: 松州之戰
battle.brief: 貞觀十二年（638）吐蕃贊普松贊干布遣使求親被拒，貞觀十四年（640）秋大軍東進、陷松州並盡取吐谷渾故地，兵鋒直抵長安；貞觀十五年（641）唐軍於洮水破之，渭水之盟乃定。卡面羅馬短劍不屬此役裝備，只能對照唐蕃步卒所持環首刀與短刀在肉搏中刺開鎗縫的用途。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰雙方，是唐王朝的邊軍體系與吐蕃帝國的東征軍。唐朝方面，自貞觀四年滅東突厥、貞觀九年平吐谷渾之後，於西面設安西都護府管轄西域，於西南以劍南道松州、隴右道鄯州與涼州為藩屏，兵制以府兵為主體，邊州另置蕃兵與團練，由長上、隊史一類基層軍官率領。貞觀十五年出兵的洮河道行軍總管侯君集所部五萬人，由京師宿衛、各道府兵與劍南、隴右募兵湊成，糧秣靠劍南道與關中轉運，遠距離調度全靠蜀道與隴右驛道。吐蕃方面，松贊干布於七世紀初兼併高原諸部，定都邏些，以大論分畫地方，兵制以部落為單位、平時牧放戰時集結，騎兵為骨幹，步卒以弓箭手與持矛持刀者為輔；給養靠隨軍氈帳、犛牛、駝羊與青稞，就地徵糧的本事有限，所以它的戰爭多沿河谷通道推進，奪城而食，不肯遠離基地。吐谷渾夾在兩者之間，其地界城邑正當唐、蕃交通的咽喉，先向唐求援，後又請吐蕃主持和親，兩度改換門庭，最終隨本國的崩潰而失勢。
countriesEn: The two parties in this war were the frontier command system of the Tang dynasty and the eastern expeditionary army of the Tibetan empire. On the Tang side, after the destruction of the Eastern Turks in 630 and of the Tuyuhun in 635, the dynasty governed the west through the Protectorate of the Western Regions and held the line in the southwest through Songzhou in Jiannan and Shanzhou and Liangzhou in Longyou; the military system rested on the fubing, while the border prefectures kept their own native and militia levies under junior officers such as the zhangshang and the duishi. The fifty thousand men that Hou Junji led in 641 as Commissioner of the Tao River route were drawn from the palace guards, the fubing of the circuits and recruits from Jiannan and Longyou, with grain moved out of Jiannan and Guanzhong and every long move made along the roads of Shu and the post stations of Longyou. On the Tibetan side, Songtsen Gampo had united the plateau tribes in the early seventh century, made Lhasa his capital, divided the country among the great ministers, and organised the army by tribe, mustered for war out of a peacetime of herding; cavalry formed the backbone and the infantry consisted of bowmen and men with spear and knife. Their supply system relied on felt tents, yaks, camels and sheep and on barley carried with the army, and their ability to provision themselves on the spot was limited, which is why their campaigns advanced along river valleys, taking cities for food and never straying far from their base. The Tuyuhun, a small state wedged between the two, sat exactly on the road between Tang and Tibet, and so it first asked Tang for help and later asked the Tibetan king to arrange a marriage, changing sides twice, and it finally lost its position as the Tuyuhun state came apart.
people: 松贊干布是吐蕃贊普，七世紀初兼併吐谷渾與高原諸部，統一吐蕃、定都邏些，創大論分封之制，對外以婚姻換取唐的承認。他派出的求婚使者兩度往返，第一次在途中折返，被唐太宗指為無禮；第二次於貞觀十二年（638）正式奉國書至長安請尚公主，被太宗婉拒，並遣使持璽書責其無禮，此事成為戰爭的導火線。唐太宗李世民是此役最高的決策者，他拒婚的考慮，一半是不願以宗女與財貨換取一時的邊境安寧，一半是看準了吐蕃爭的是青海與河湟的通道；到渭水相會時他仍親自出面，以少量隨從與對方統帥直接議定退兵。侯君集是唐軍主將，時任兵部尚書，貞觀十五年（641）以洮河道行軍總管率步騎五萬赴青海，在洮水一線擊破吐蕃先鋒，斬首數千級、俘牛羊萬餘頭，隨後收復鄯、廓一線。薛仁貴時在侯君集麾下作戰，於近旁戰線以少量兵力破敵，是此役唐方將領中最見銳氣的一人。吐谷渾君長慕容氏夾在兩強之間，貞觀九年（635）其首領慕容伏允為李靖所破，餘部先後降唐、又請吐蕃主持和親，隨本國的崩潰而失勢。
peopleEn: Songtsen Gampo was the Tibetan king. In the early seventh century he absorbed the Tuyuhun and the other tribes of the plateau, united the Tibetan people, moved the capital to Lhasa and created the system of the great ministers, and he used marriage to win recognition from Tang. The envoy he sent to fetch a princess turned back on the road and the Tang emperor treated that as discourtesy; a second embassy came properly to Chang'an with a national letter in the twelfth year of Zhenguan (638), asking to marry a princess, and it was politely refused and answered with a written rebuke, and that answer became the spark of the war. The Tang emperor Li Shimin was the supreme decision maker of the campaign. His refusal was in part unwillingness to buy a temporary peace on the frontier with a clanswoman and treasure, and in part a clear reading of the Tibetan interest in the Qinghai and Huangshui corridors; at the Wei River he still came out in person and settled the withdrawal with the opposing commander face to face with only a small escort. Hou Junji was the Tang commander, then Minister of War, appointed in the fifteenth year of Zhenguan (641) as Commissioner of the Tao River route with fifty thousand foot and horse; he broke the Tibetan vanguard at the Tao River, taking several thousand heads and more than ten thousand head of cattle and sheep, and afterwards recovered the Shanzhou and Guozhou line. Xue Rengui fought in the same campaign under Hou Junji and won a small action on the neighbouring front with few troops, showing the sharpest instinct among the Tang commanders. The Murong rulers of the Tuyuhun were caught between two powers: in the ninth year of Zhenguan (635) their leader Murong Fuyun was broken by Li Jing, and the survivors submitted to Tang and then invited the Tibetan king to mediate a marriage, losing their position as the Tuyuhun state came apart.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是公元前後的羅馬短劍（Gladius），羅馬軍團士兵的標準副手武器，直刃雙刃、劍身約六十公分、重心靠近護手，以刺擊為主而劈砍為輔；它並不存在於松州之戰，只能當作短刺型手兵的一個原型來對照。與它在本戰役中位置相同的，是唐蕃兩軍士卒隨身攜帶的短刀：唐軍邊軍以環首刀為主，直刃、無格或微弧，環首纏繩以便懸掛於腰，另有鍔與鞘；吐蕃兵依《新唐書·吐蕃傳》所述，衣裘、佩大刀、長弓以角為胎，其短刀形制厚重，拔取容易。在短兵相接的最後一程，長矛與弓箭射程都已喪失，環首刀與短刀要完成的正與短劍相同：刺開對手鎧甲的搭接處、割斷馬韁與喉管。真正決定戰役走向的卻是投射兵器與騎兵。唐軍步卒以弓、弩、方頭戟、標槍列陣，槍手居前、弓弩在後，騎兵用長槊與長刀；鎧甲延續隋代的明光鎧與札甲制度，戰馬自貞觀末年開始披具裝鎧；攻城與營壘器材則是雲梯、撞車、火箭、橇車與拒馬。給養方面，劍南道沿劍門道運糧入松州，吐蕃靠氈帳、犛牛與青稞就地取給；雙方真正的差距在後勤，而不在刀劍。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman gladius, the standard sidearm of the Roman legionary, a straight double-edged blade about sixty centimetres long with its weight near the guard, built for the thrust with the cut as a secondary use. It did not exist at Songzhou, and it can serve only as a prototype against which to read the short thrusting hand weapons of the period. The direct equivalent on the two sides in this campaign was the short knife carried by the foot soldier. Tang frontier troops relied on the ring-pommel dao, straight-bladed and ungrooved or slightly curved, with a ring at the pommel wrapped in cord so that it could be hung at the belt, together with a guard and a scabbard; Tibetans, as the New History of the Tang records, wore sheepskin, carried large knives and used long bows with horn backing, and their short knives were heavy in build and easy to draw among the grass and in front of the tents. In the last stage of close combat, when spear reach and bow range had both been lost, the ring-pommel dao and the short knife had to do exactly what the gladius did: open a seam in the enemy's armour, cut a bridle or a throat. What really decided the campaign, however, were the missile weapons and the cavalry. Tang infantry formed up with bows, crossbows, halberds with square blades and javelins, spear-men in front and archers behind; the cavalry used long lances and long sabres; armour continued the Sui inheritance of the bright lamellar and the plated coat; and war horses were beginning to be covered with harness armour in the last years of Zhenguan. The siege and field equipment was the ladder, the ram, fire arrows, the wheeled shield and the chevaux-de-frise. On supply, grain moved into Songzhou along the Jianmen road of Jiannan, while the Tibetans provisioned themselves on the spot with felt tents, yaks and barley. The difference between the two sides lay in logistics rather than in knives.
tactics: 吐蕃的東進是一條典型的河谷走廊戰役。松贊干布先以騎兵向東掃清吐谷渾的城邑，把鄯、廓一帶變成前進的補給地，再以大軍沿青海、湟水谷地南下，取松州，破川西要塞，爾後分兵深入隴右，直抵長安近郊。松州一線是劍南道的北面門戶，城依岷江上游的高地而築，道路狹窄，援軍只能沿江谷逐次投入；吐蕃以步騎配合，先以弩手與投石壓制城頭，再驅趕部眾填塞壕塹、攀緣破城，唐軍則退守城中，待援兵到齊再圖反攻。唐軍在青海方面的處置是先守後反：侯君集率五萬人屯於鄯州一線，以步騎夾擊吐蕃先鋒於洮水，得勝後追奔數百里，盡取吐谷渾故地；長安方面則嚴禁大軍入城，只遣少量宿衛在渭橋一線佈陣，太宗親至渭水與松贊干布相見，約定和親並限期退兵，兩軍各按次第撤離。公主入蕃的路線則經劍南道出松州、轉入河湟道，隨行有佛像、經典、種子、工具與牲畜，隊伍前後綿延於山谷之間。
tacticsEn: The Tibetan advance was a textbook corridor campaign along a river valley. Songtsen Gampo first used cavalry to sweep away the Tuyuhun cities eastward, turning Shanzhou and Guozhou into a forward supply base, then drove the main body down the Qinghai and Huangshui valleys, took Songzhou, broke the fortress line in western Sichuan, and afterwards split off columns to penetrate Longyou and reach the neighbourhood of Chang'an. Songzhou was the northern gate of Jiannan, its site chosen on high ground above the upper Min River, where the road is narrow and reinforcements can only be fed in piecemeal along the river valley. The Tibetians combined foot and horse, used crossbowmen and stone-throwers to pin the walls, then drove their formations into the ditches and up the slopes, while the Tang retired inside the city and waited for the relieving troops before thinking of a counterattack. On the Qinghai side the Tang chose to hold first and counterattack later: Hou Junji brought fifty thousand men to the Shanzhou line, caught the Tibetan vanguard between foot and horse at the Tao River, and after the victory pursued them for several hundred li and took back the old Tuyuhun land. At Chang'an a large army was kept out of the city and only a small escort was posted at the Wei bridge, while the emperor came in person to the Wei River, met Songtsen Gampo, and agreed on the marriage and on a fixed date for the withdrawal; both sides then pulled out in order. The princess's procession left by the Jiannan road through Songzhou and turned into the Huangshui road, with statues, scriptures, seeds, tools and beasts of the train strung out along the valleys.
data: 可考的時間點與數字如下。貞觀十二年（638），吐蕃贊普松贊干布遣使奉國書入唐請尚公主，太宗不許，並遣使持書責之。貞觀十四年（640）秋，吐蕃大軍東進，傳稱二十萬眾，陷松州，盡取吐谷渾故地，吐谷渾餘眾向唐求援。貞觀十五年（641）正月，唐以侯君集為洮河道行軍總管，率步騎五萬赴援；君集等破吐蕃於洮水，斬首數千級、俘牛羊萬餘頭，追奔數百里，收復鄯、廓一線。同年，吐蕃大軍進至長安近郊，渭水之盟成，宗女弘化公主、文成公主先後入蕃。兵員方面，吐蕃的二十萬是史籍沿用的概數，實際出動當遠少於此數；唐軍五萬為通鑑所記的出征數，並非同時在線的全部兵力。地理上，松州在今四川松潘縣，扼岷江上游，西距鄯州（今青海西寧）約一千四百里，是劍南道最北的邊州；松州至長安的道路全程約二千里，按唐代行程需四十餘日。器物方面，唐軍一線裝備弓弩、方頭戟、標槍、明光鎧與環首刀，吐蕃以角胎長弓、大刀與氈帳為主。
dataEn: The datable points and figures are as follows. In the twelfth year of Zhenguan (638) the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo sent an embassy with a national letter to ask for a princess in marriage; the emperor refused and sent an envoy back with a written rebuke. In the autumn of the fourteenth year of Zhenguan (640) the main Tibetan army moved east, conventionally said to have numbered two hundred thousand, took Songzhou, swept up the old Tuyuhun territory, and the remnants of the Tuyuhun turned to Tang for help. In the first month of the fifteenth year of Zhenguan (641) the court appointed Hou Junji Commissioner of the Tao River route with fifty thousand foot and horse; Junji and his men broke the Tibetans at the Tao River, taking several thousand heads and more than ten thousand cattle and sheep, pursued them for several hundred li and recovered the Shanzhou and Guozhou line. In the same year the main Tibetan force reached the neighbourhood of Chang'an, the agreement on the Wei River was concluded, and the imperial clanswomen Honghua and Wencheng were sent into Tibet in turn. On numbers: the two hundred thousand Tibetans are a conventional figure carried in the histories, and the force actually committed was much smaller; the fifty thousand Tang troops is the figure recorded in the Comprehensive Mirror for the expedition and was not the whole of the force simultaneously in the line. On geography, Songzhou is in present-day Songpan county in Sichuan, commanding the upper Min River, about 1,400 li west of Shanzhou, present-day Xining in Qinghai, and it was the northernmost border prefecture of Jiannan; the road from Songzhou to Chang'an ran about two thousand li and took an army rather more than forty days. On equipment, the Tang line carried bows, crossbows, square-bladed halberds, javelins, bright lamellar armour and ring-pommel sabres, while the Tibetans relied on horn-backed long bows, large knives and felt tents.
cause: 直接起因是唐太宗拒絕了吐蕃的和親。松贊干布第一次遣使迎娶公主，走到半途折返；第二次於貞觀十二年（638）正式上表求婚。廷議時群臣多以遠方小國不足以繫中國安危為由主張婉拒，太宗也不願以宗女與財貨換取一時的邊境安寧，於是遣使持璽書數落吐蕃無禮。求婚被拒之後，吐蕃轉而用兵：一方面吞併吐谷渾所控制的青海與河湟諸城，把前線推到唐的松州、鄯州門面；另一方面藉此向唐施壓，要求重新議婚。更深一層的背景，是貞觀前期唐朝剛平定東突厥、吐谷渾與高句麗，國力正盛，卻也正需要一條明確的邊界來框定西北方向的新秩序，而吐蕃恰恰要在這個方向上爭取與唐平起平坐的地位。於是求婚使者的一次折返、一封被退回的國書，成為兩個帝國在青海地區全面對撞的序曲。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the Tang emperor's refusal of a Tibetan marriage alliance. Songtsen Gampo had first sent an envoy to fetch a princess, and that envoy turned back on the road; in the twelfth year of Zhenguan (638) a second embassy came properly to Chang'an with a petition to marry a princess. The ministers at court mostly argued that a distant small state was not worth binding the safety of the middle kingdom to, and the emperor was genuinely unwilling to buy a temporary peace on the frontier with a clanswoman and treasure, so he sent an envoy back with a sealed letter reproaching the Tibetans for their discourtesy. Once the marriage was refused, the Tibetans turned to arms: on one hand they swallowed the Qinghai and Huangshui cities held by the Tuyuhun and pushed the front up to the gates of Songzhou and Shanzhou; on the other they used the pressure of war to force Tang back to the marriage table. Deeper down, the Tang had just settled the Eastern Turks, the Tuyuhun and Goguryeo in the early Zhenguan years. The state was at its strongest and at the same time in need of a clear line to fix the new order in the northwest, and Tibet meant to claim an equal footing with Tang precisely in that direction. So a single envoy who turned back and a national letter sent home were the prelude to a head-on collision between two empires over the Qinghai region.
impact: 這場戰爭的第一重影響在外交：渭水之盟開了唐朝與吐蕃以和親維持邊界的先例，宗女弘化公主與文成公主先後入蕃，隨行的佛像、經典、工匠、醫藥與種子從此沿河源道與劍南道北段源源流入吐蕃，吐蕃的制度、天文曆算與金屬工藝也沿同一條路反向進入唐境。第二重影響在戰略：唐朝以一次邊境上的挫敗換來了大陸腹地的安定，得以把主力轉向遼東，貞觀十九年（645）出兵高句麗、翌年平定高句麗，貞觀末年又在漠北掃平鐵勒，都建立在渭水之盟換來的這段空窗之上。對吐蕃而言，松州與河湟的得手證明了它可以與唐在戰場上直接較量，也讓它把青海與川西當作向東、向南擴張的跳板；只是此後它與唐在松州、涼州一線的反覆拉鋸，把高原與西南的邊界拖成了長達數百年的消耗戰，直到八世紀初才由安西都護府與劍南節度使的體系大致框定。軍備上，渭水之盟後唐廷加強松州、鄯州的城防與屯兵，邊軍的具裝騎兵與弩兵編制在這幾年裡明顯增加，環首刀、方頭戟這類制式手兵也在劍南、隴右各鎮得到補充。
impactEn: The first effect of the war was diplomatic. The agreement on the Wei River set the precedent for holding the frontier with marriage ties between Tang and Tibet. The imperial clanswomen Honghua and Wencheng went into Tibet in turn, and the statues, scriptures, craftsmen, medicines and seeds that travelled with them flowed into Tibet along the Heyuan road and the northern stretch of the Jiannan road, while Tibetan institutions, calendrical science and metalworking came back the other way along the same road. The second effect was strategic. Tang bought the peace of the interior with a defeat on the frontier and could turn its main strength to Liaodong: it campaigned against Goguryeo in 645 and destroyed it in 646, and in the last years of Zhenguan it swept the Tiele in the northern desert, all of which rested on the quiet bought at the Wei River. For Tibet, the taking of Songzhou and the Huangshui region proved that it could meet Tang on the field, and made Qinghai and western Sichuan a springboard for expansion east and south. The repeated tug of war that followed along Songzhou and Liangzhou, however, turned the plateau and the southwestern frontier into a struggle of several centuries, and it was not roughly settled by Tang until the Protectorate of the Western Regions and the jiedushi system of Jiannan had been established at the beginning of the eighth century. On the military side, after the agreement the court strengthened the walls and the garrisons of Songzhou and Shanzhou; the harness-armoured cavalry and the crossbow strength of the frontier increased visibly in those years, and the standard hand weapons of the border districts, the ring-pommel dao and the square-bladed halberd, were replenished in Jiannan and Longyou.
result: 以戰果論，松州之戰對唐朝是一次明確的失利：貞觀十四年（640）秋吐蕃陷松州、盡取吐谷渾故地，兵鋒直抵長安近郊，唐朝沒有在戰場上擋住它。以手段論，結果卻是成功的：唐太宗在渭水親與松贊干布相見，約定和親並限期退兵，吐蕃退回青海與河湟，唐軍保住了涇州與長安，並在隨後的洮水之戰中由侯君集破敵、收復鄯廓，把戰線推回吐谷渾故地。以長期論，這場戰爭的直接產物是唐蕃之間維持了約半個世紀的和親與互市體系，641年兩位宗女入蕃，直到八世紀初關係才全面破裂。松州一線此後仍屢遭攻掠，唐朝先後失去了在松州與鄯、廓的經營，670年大非川之役薛仁貴全軍失利是這條邊界的最低點，而整個唐蕃邊界的大致格局，要到吐蕃內亂與唐蕃在青海的最後較量之後才重新畫定。今日的判斷是：松州之戰是唐蕃關係的第一次正面碰撞，唐朝以戰場上的失分換來了時間，而時間最終站在了唐朝這一邊。
resultEn: Judged by battlefield results, the Songzhou campaign was a clear defeat for Tang: in the autumn of 640 the Tibetans took Songzhou, swept the old Tuyuhun land and drove their spearhead to the neighbourhood of Chang'an, and Tang could not stop them in the field. Judged by method, the outcome was a success: Li Shimin met Songtsen Gampo in person at the Wei River, agreed the marriage and a fixed date for the withdrawal, the Tibetans fell back to Qinghai and the Huangshui, Tang saved Jingzhou and Chang'an, and in the fighting that followed Hou Junji defeated the enemy at the Tao River and recovered Shanzhou and Guozhou, pushing the line back to the old Tuyuhun territory. Judged in the long run, the direct product of the war was a marriage and trade system between Tang and Tibet that held for roughly half a century: two imperial clanswomen went into Tibet in 641, and the relationship was not comprehensively broken until the beginning of the eighth century. The Songzhou line was raided again and again, and Tang lost its footing at Songzhou and in Shanzhou and Guozhou; the defeat of Xue Rengui at Dafeichuan in 670 was the lowest point of that frontier, and the overall shape of the Tang-Tibetan border was only redrawn after the internal disorder in Tibet and the last struggles over Qinghai. The judgement today is that Songzhou was the first direct collision between the two empires, that Tang traded a loss on the field for time, and that in the end the time was on Tang's side.
